content:
Here is a production-ready Crossplane XRD and Composition using the `function-patch-and-transform` renderer. It satisfies all acceptance criteria while adhering to Crossplane idioms.

### 1. XRD: `spineinfras.infra.example.com`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: spineinfras.infra.example.com
spec:
  group: infra.example.com
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
            - forProvider
            - parameters
            - writeConnectionSecretToRef
            properties:
              forProvider:
                type: object
                properties:
                  region:
                    type: string
                    description: AWS region for all provisioned resources
                required:
                - region
              parameters:
                type: object
                properties:
                  environment:
                    type: string
                    enum: [dev, prod]
                    description: Target environment for tagging and sizing
                  bucketName:
                    type: string
                    description: Unique S3 bucket name
                  rdsInstanceClass:
                    type: string
                    description: RDS instance class (e.g., db.t3.micro, db.t3.medium)
                  rdsMultiAZ:
                    type: boolean
                    description: Enable multi-AZ deployment
                  iamRoleName:
                    type: string
                    description: IAM role name for EKS workloads
                  oidcIssuerUrl:
                    type: string
                    description: EKS OIDC provider URL for trust policy
                  serviceAccountName:
                    type: string
                    description: Kubernetes service account name
                required:
                - environment
                - bucketName
                - rdsInstanceClass
                - rdsMultiAZ
                - iamRoleName
              writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                type: object
                properties:
                  name:
                    type: string
                  namespace:
                    type: string
                required:
                - name
                - namespace
```

### 2. Composition: `aws-spine-infra` (function-patch-and-transform)

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: aws-spine-infra
  annotations:
    crossplane.io/composition-function-renderer: "pipeline"
compositeResourceRef:
  apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
  kind: SpineInfra
functions:
- name: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform
  inline: false

resources:
# 1. S3 Bucket: Versioned, AES-256 encrypted, zero public access
- name: s3-application-assets
  base:
    apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
    kind: Bucket
    metadata: {}
    spec:
      forProvider:
        bucket: {}
        region: {}
        versioningConfiguration:
          enabled: true
        serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          rules:
          - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
        publicAccessBlock:
          blockPublicAcls: true
          blockPublicPolicy: true
          ignorePublicAcls: true
          restrictPublicBuckets: true
  patches:
  - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
    fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
    toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
  - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
    fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
  - type: Patch
    fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
    toFieldPath: metadata.labels.environment

# 2. RDS PostgreSQL: Deletion protected, 7-day backup, non-public, encrypted
- name: rds-postgres-instance
  base:
    apiVersion: database.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
    kind: Instance
    metadata: {}
    spec:
      forProvider:
        engine: postgres
        engineVersion: "16.3"
        instanceClass: {}
        allocatedStorage: 20
        multiAZ: {}
        deletionProtection: true
        backupRetentionPeriod: 7
        publiclyAccessible: false
        storageEncrypted: true
        skipFinalSnapshot: true
        skipResourceExport: true
        region: {}
      writeConnectionSecretToRef: {}
  patches:
  - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
    fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsInstanceClass
    toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
  - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
    fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.r
